issues.description: Reviewers report being unable to get into their account, with one saying hacking wiped their playlists and another complaining about the cost and ads.
issues.title: Locked out of account and data lost

issues.description: A reviewer reports getting a "no token provided" message that they cannot fix, which is frustrating enough to consider cancelling.
issues.title: Persistent token error prevents using app

issues.description: Reviewers say they cannot log in, reporting rejected passwords, false no-internet messages, repeated demands for a new contact number, and a phone number check that fails even when correct.
issues.title: Login fails with password or connection errors

issues.description: Reviewers say the latest policy restricts free users, with some noting that basic functions like playing tracks in order now require premium and leaving the app.
issues.title: Free users face heavy restrictions and paywalls

issues.description: Reviewers object to having to pay for better audio quality, repeating songs, or basic features, and some say they are uninstalling the app.
issues.title: Paying for basic features feels unfair

issues.description: Reviewers say they must pay for premium to repeat, skip, or pick specific songs, with shuffle-only playback and a limit of six skips.
issues.title: Basic playback controls locked behind premium

issues.description: Reviewers report that after an update, playing next tracks, choosing music, and playing parts of songs require premium, and some lost playback entirely after subscribing.
issues.title: Core features moved behind premium paywall

issues.description: Reviewers say the catalog feels thin in some genres, the app seems empty, and it recommends songs they do not want.
issues.title: Music selection seems limited or unwanted

issues.description: Reviewers report that lyrics sometimes do not appear, inconsistently across songs, including for playlist songs, and say this worsened after an update.
issues.title: Lyrics missing or fail to load

issues.description: One reviewer says many songs they look for are not present in the app.
issues.title: Many songs unavailable in the app

issues.description: Reviewers say recommendations appear in their playlists even after turning off the setting and removing them, and some miss the older, larger recommendation selections.
issues.title: Recommendations ignore settings and repeat playlist songs

issues.description: A reviewer asks for the search function within playlists to be restored, calling its removal a serious mistake.
issues.title: Playlist search function removed

issues.description: Reviewers report being unable to download music, and say previously downloaded content disappears after a few months, including when offline, undermining their Premium subscription.
issues.title: Downloads fail or disappear unexpectedly

issues.description: Reviewers say they can no longer listen offline or log in, and that the music files are faulty.
issues.title: Offline listening and login broken

issues.description: A reviewer reports that the offline feature is not working.
issues.title: Offline mode does not work

issues.description: Reviewers say they are uninstalling or boycotting the app over content they object to, citing Quran burnings, the platform's support for certain groups, and specific podcasters.
issues.title: Users boycotting over political and religious objections

issues.description: A reviewer says the app has many bugs and is not user friendly.
issues.title: App has many bugs and poor usability

issues.description: Reviewers give broad negative verdicts, calling the app the worst they have used and giving it no stars, without naming a specific problem.
issues.title: General dissatisfaction with the app overall

issues.description: Reviewers say the latest update removed features, made the app useless, and was disappointing, leading some to advise others not to update or to uninstall.
issues.title: Recent update removed features and made app worse

issues.description: A reviewer says the app uses up data and storage on their phone.
issues.title: App wastes data and phone storage

issues.description: Reviewers say Spotify shows a no internet connection message or fails to load on Wi-Fi even though other apps and mobile data work fine.
issues.title: App reports no internet despite working connection

issues.description: Reviewers report that Spotify crashes or will not open after a recent update, though it worked before.
issues.title: App crashes after latest update

issues.description: Reviewers report problems with Google Assistant playback, casting to other devices, and connecting to devices such as consoles or PCs.
issues.title: Trouble connecting and casting to devices

issues.description: Reviewers describe songs changing on their own, the app starting without permission, alarm connection failures, and other unexplained playback behavior.
issues.title: Unexpected playback and app behavior

issues.description: A reviewer wants hi-res audio and says playlist recommendations appear even when the option is turned off.
issues.title: Requests for hi-res audio and fewer recommendations

issues.description: Reviewers say playback stops randomly or lags during songs and podcasts, and does not resume where it left off.
issues.title: Music stops or lags mid-playback

issues.description: Reviewers report a black screen, a stuck loading logo, or songs that will not play at all, even with a good network connection.
issues.title: App stuck on loading or won't play music

issues.description: Reviewers say the app plays too many ads between songs, including ads in the middle of tracks, and some find this frustrating enough to lower their rating.
issues.title: Too many ads during listening

issues.description: Reviewers complain about a worse lyrics font, bugs such as broken music adjustment, a wish for more control, and being unable to open Spotify Wrap 2022.
issues.title: Bugs, font changes, and missing controls

issues.description: Reviewers find the redesigned layout confusing, with oversized icons and too much scrolling to reach content, and say it is hard for older users.
issues.title: New layout is hard to navigate

issues.description: Reviewers say the new home screen makes playlists hard to find, Liked Songs does not show, and only 30-second clips play for some tracks.
issues.title: New home screen hides playlists and liked songs

issues.description: Reviewers say they cannot skip freely through playlists, cannot repeat or play specific parts, and the new menu only allows shuffle, and some songs open a demo instead.
issues.title: Limited skipping, repeat, and playback control

issues.description: A reviewer says the update removed the ability to go back a few seconds while playing music and threatens to delete the app.
issues.title: Update removed ability to rewind a few seconds
